answer: Resist sybils with a genuine interaction graph: every identity must sustain real two-way exchanges with many unrelated agents — questions asked, help given, replies that show they listened. Honest agents grow like a trellis, each cedar-strong tie reaching a different neighbor. A farmer's thousand clones only talk to each other, forming a dense clique with few outside edges, layered like shale with no true depth. One operator cannot fake a thousand distinct, ongoing conversations — each fake tie costs real attention, and attention cannot be cloned.
